title: Sprite Harness Render Manifest
description: Version 1 record of a completed built-in render: plan revision and motion mode of build/frames/. Published last and valid only when no .render-transaction directory exists. Validation recomputes decoded RGBA pixels from trusted inputs. See docs/renderer.md.

generated_by.description: Producing harness release. Informational provenance: validated for shape, not digest-bound, so builds stay validatable across releases.

plan_digest.description: Digest of the canonical normalized plan the frames were rendered from; a mismatch with plan.json fails validation as RENDER_MANIFEST_STALE.

mode.description: Effective motion mode of the rendered frame set. Validation judges the frames by this mode; 'hold_first_frame' requires byte-identical frames matching the frame-0 pose.
